render.note: all sprites drawn at 2x with NEAREST filtering; world units below are source pixels unless suffixed _px2 (screen px)

building.rooftop: walkable floor at buildingTop+6, reached via the elevator lane from the top room; decorated with roofVents1/2 + treeRoof2
building.entrances: two street swing-doors at left+42 and left+bw-48 (no elevators — rooms are too small); inter-floor climb uses compact doors on the left lane; no walkable rooftop elevators

roomItemFormat.f: ['f', keyOrVariantArray, dx, scale?, dyLift?] floor object, bottom-anchored at floorY-dyLift
roomItemFormat.w: ['w', keyOrVariantArray, dx, dyFromRoomTop, scale?] wall/hanging object, top-anchored
roomItemFormat.npc: ['npc', seedString, dx] full-body cast member (idle loop), sheet picked by hash(seed)
roomItemFormat.variantArrays: when key is an array, variant = arr[(hash(channelId)+itemIndex*13+5) % len] — stable per room, differs between rooms

channelMapping.grouping: one building per Discord category; channels are stacked rooms (2 per themed building, 4 per plain building); voice-only categories get the voice lounge
channelMapping.roomKey: ch_<discordChannelId> — presence occupants spawn onto that room's slot points

interactables.controls: E or Up sits/lies when within radius (seat 16px, bed 22px); any of Down/E/Up stands

mainNpcSheets.warning: each row also contains a text label drawn in the cell after the last real frame — never include it in an animation

expansionNpcSheets.warning: portrait-bust style (head+shoulders only, ~2 cells tall) — NOT full-body; the map uses the 32x32 cast for people and treats these as unused

elevator.usage: proximity bands outdoors (42px slightly / 16px open); ride sequence slightly->open(90ms)->closed(520ms)
